prompt.text:
Implement `computeStripView(items, start, visibleCount, action)` and export exactly `{ computeStripView }` using CommonJS. `items` must be an array of plain objects; `start` must be a nonnegative integer; `visibleCount` must be a positive integer; and `action` must be exactly one of `'stay'`, `'left'`, `'right'`, or `'advance'`. Clamp the supplied start to the largest valid start, defined as `max(0, items.length - visibleCount)`. `left` subtracts one with a floor of zero, `right` adds one with a ceiling of the largest valid start, and `advance` adds one but wraps to zero after the largest valid start. For an empty array every action yields start zero. Return `{ start, visibleItems, canLeft, canRight }`. `visibleItems` contains shallow copies of the selected items in original order; flags describe whether manual movement is possible from the returned position. Throw `TypeError` for malformed arguments. Do not mutate inputs or retain item object aliases.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
